name: Jasmine
text: This home was by far the best home our family has chosen for our annual family vacation. We were impressed with all of the amenities provided and the cleanliness of the home. We would definitely stay here again.

name: Anna Katherine
text: This place was perfect for a long weekend getaway! Upon arrival, everything was spotless. The home was stocked with all important kitchen & bathroom. The mountain views were incredible! Highly recommend staying here!!!

name: Sampath
text: This Airbnb is absolutely flawless! I don't even know where to begin. This is by far the best Airbnb we've ever stayed at in the U.S. It is absolutely gorgeous—the photos simply don't do it justice.The beds are incredibly comfortable, and everything was spotless. Ann and Jonathan have truly thought of every little detail to make guests feel welcome. The kitchen was one of our favorite features. It is exceptionally well stocked, with every spice you could need, and we were pleasantly surprised to find a rice cooker as well!The views are stunning and made our stay even more special. Honestly, there is nothing negative to say. I could go on and on about how wonderful this place is, but one thing is certain—you will not be disappointed if you choose to spend your vacation here.We are already hoping to come back soon. Thank you, Ann and Jonathan, for your outstanding hospitality. You truly are Superhosts!

name: Angela
text: This home was absolutely stunning! As we walked in, each of us said "wow!". The view, however, was beyond words. The home sits a top a mountain that overlooks a lush and green valley (in July). We loved sitting in the bedroom or on the decks just staring out over the valley. We were immediately comfortable there. The beds were supremely comfortable, from the mattress to the bedding. The bathrooms were luxurious. The kitchen was beyond well stocked. The teenagers spent most of their time in the game room. The pool table was a real hit!! We will definitely be coming back to this gorgeous destination!

name: Karen
text: We loved our stay and appreciate what a great host Jonathan is. The house was beautiful and just perfect for our family to gather and relax. The coffee bar, provided toiletries, and even having laundry supplies on hand are very nice touches. Jonathan was polite, informative and helpful. It was an enjoyable stay from start to finish and I would highly recommend a stay here.

name: Megan
text: Such a beautiful house. We loved the views and the inside of the house was incredible. Jonathan gave so many great recommendations and checked in to make sure everything was going ok. We loved staying here!

name: Brenda
text: The golf course at Bryce -5 minutes from the house- is a hidden gem

name: Beth
text: The setting was beautiful, house was very nice.

name: Stephanie
text: This house was perfect for my group of friends and dog! The view from the deck was a real highlight and the space was exactly as described. We would come back in a heartbeat.

name: Zoe
text: The view! Absolutely stunning. Kitchen is equipped to have all meals in and the bedrooms and common areas are all comfortable with enough space for a group to hang together or individuals to find a bit of quiet solitude. Lovely home for a relaxing weekend away or fun get-together with friends or family.

name: Vijay
text: Loved our stay here. We were looking for a mountain getaway for friend and families that would be dog and toddler friendly and this house was both. Really thoughtfully appointed with everything you could need and a beautiful space. Great water temperature and pressure on the showers. Fast internet and streaming. Good selection of games and activities. And one of the best equipped kitchens I've used in an AirBnB with lots of space to prep and cook. Hosts were always responsive and had lots of helpful tips to the area.

name: Tchato
text: We love the place. Went there for a weekend getaway with friends. Amazing views.

name: Eliza
text: You cannot beat this view! Waking up to the sounds of birds and the wind through the trees would've been enough but this home is truly the perfect location for gathering with friends or family and spending time together! Jonathan was super accommodating with an early check-in and any questions we had. We were steps away from the ski slopes, which was really fun to walk around in the Spring! We had The Who mountain to ourselves! We would absolutely stay here again!

name: Madelyn
text: My husband and I wanted a weekend away with our dogs to relax and that's exactly what we got staying here. The house is beautiful with insanely gorgeous views! We sat outside with the propane fire table and watched the sun set behind the mountains every night. We also walked the pups throughout the streets surrounding the house and visited the dog park (just over a mile from the house!) every day. The guestbook Jonathan provided was especially impressive and so thoughtfully put together. It covered everything we could possibly need, from details about the home itself to recommendations and tips for enjoying the area. It really felt like every detail had been considered to make our stay as comfortable and enjoyable as possible. We couldn't have asked for a better getaway and would absolutely stay again!

name: Matt
text: Very nice place. Exactly as advertised!

name: Naomi
text: The cabin truly exceeded expectations! From the smooth booking process to Jonathan's guide and prompt responses, everything made the stay enjoyable. The home was very clean, and the views were absolutely stunning. It's the perfect place for either a relaxing getaway or a staycation. I would definitely recommend this place and can't wait to go back!

name: Madison
text: Had a great time. Would definitely book again ! House was beautiful and well stocked.

name: Lisha
text: The house was AMAZING. My retirement celebration getaway was everything I envisioned. Peaceful, relaxing, tranquil and quiet. Im definitely going to book again.

name: Lisa
text: We felt "at home" the minute we walked through the door. We stayed in this home last Winter also-- and LOVED it. We're already looking forward to next year. We chose Jonathan's home when our beloved dachshund Sally accompanied us everywhere. It fit all of the filters we set--and was the clear winner. Sadly, we don't currently have a pet and could've expanded our filter to include many other homes. We took a vote and unanimously agreed to return to our "home away from home" in the mountains. The view is AMAZING. We also love the layout of the home. Our family of 7 ranges from 2-64 years old. The safety gates are a huge PLUS! The coffee/tea bar is important to us. Yes, we are coffee snobs! The bedroom arrangement is great. Jonathan is VERY communicative, friendly and accommodating. While at Bryce, we enjoyed skiing, sledding, tubing, neighborhood walks and sharing meals together. Most of all, we enjoyed one another. This home is a perfect gathering place for just that!

name: Kendall
text: We loved our stay here in Basye! The house was exactly as described and Jonathan was an INCREDIBLE host! Everything we needed was provided (plus extras!) and the home was incredibly clean! The home was exactly as it looked in the pictures with a breathtaking view and sleek and modern interior decor. Jonathan was easy to contact and was always available if we needed any help. We would definitely stay here again! One of the best Airbnb's we've ever stayed in!

name: Jim
text: Jonathan and Anna's mountain cabin retreat at the top of Bryce Mountain was absolutely wonderful and exceeded all of our expectations. The house itself is beautiful, thoughtfully designed, and impeccably clean, making it easy to relax the moment we arrived. The panoramic views of the Shenandoah mountains are truly breathtaking—whether enjoying morning coffee on the deck or watching the sunset, the scenery never got old.The location is incredibly convenient, just minutes from Bryce Resort, yet it still feels peaceful and tucked away. The layout of the cabin worked perfectly for our group, offering comfortable spaces for adults to unwind and great areas for children to play and feel at home. Every detail seemed well considered, from the furnishings to the amenities.Jonathan and Anna were outstanding hosts -warm, welcoming, and extremely responsive before and during our stay. They made us feel genuinely cared for and ensured everything was seamless. We would absolutely stay here again

name: Rickey
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The views are spectacular and it was fun to watch the skiers start down the slopes as we walked the dogs. The house met all our needs—well equipped kitchen, comfortable beds, and the downstairs game room with the pool table was a hit with the family!

name: Jahangir
text: We had a family of 8 with 3 kids, and we all had an amazing relaxing time at the house. It truly felt like we had checked into our own private resort. Everything from booking, to checking in, to checking out, was a breeze. Jonathan was also responsive within minutes of messaging. The house itself is gorgeous! Everything felt very luxurious, from bathroom accessories, to towels, to bedsheets. We cooked several family meals at the kitchen. The kitcheb had everything we could need and more. We will definitely be back again. Thank you so much!!

name: Rachel
text: Jonathan's place is STUNNING, we'd love to go back and stay again some day! Perfect spot for a big group that wants space to hang out. And an impressively stocked kitchen that made it super easy for us to cook! Loved this spot, views were absolutely incredible too!

name: Christian
text: My family and I had an incredible time with the amazing views and modern interior space. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a peaceful and relaxing stay.

name: Robert
text: Beautiful view and great place for freinds to hang out!

name: Aaron
text: Our stay was fantastic and the home was a dream. We absolutely loved the views and the amenities. Highly recommend for a family getaway!

name: George
text: I chose this cabin for the view and it did not disappoint. Jonathan was a friendly, responsive host. I liked the modern architecture of the cabin with the long sight lines and high ceiling. The kitchen was well equipped.

name: Reem
text: We loved it here! Really beautiful home and FANTASTIC views from every room. Very clean and loved that the kitchen was fully stocked! The beds were super comfortable too. We will come back again soon!Huge thanks to the host👏🏼😃

name: Maria
text: Wanted to look for a cabin to celebrate my birthday with my family but also to begin a family tradition. The house was large enough for all of us including 4 screaming children to comfortably lounge and relax. The home is beautiful and came with so much more than we imagined. Every night the boys played pool in the basement, the girls swung on the chairs in the living area and we grilled just about every night. The view was incredible. We brought 5 cars and there was just enough street parking to fit us all perfectly. There is no outdoor space however we didn't feel as if it were totally necessary. My family loved the home so much everyone was taking notes for their own homes. Thank you Jonathan for providing a space that brought us together and we hope to come back! Incredible home, incredible views, it was more than I could've hoped for. Thank you!

name: Nirisha
text: We enjoyed the mountain view and loved watching clouds in the mountains.Kitched is fully stocked starting from oven, blender, airfryer, toaster and all kitchen untensils. We can hear bird sounds with nice breeze. Pleasant and peaceful trip!! Jonathan is very responsive and accomodative. Highly reccomend this place for all future visitors.

name: Irina
text: Thank you so much for hosting my family at your beautiful home! We truly enjoyed our stay and can't wait to come back. The house was very clean and fully stocked with everything that we needed. Those views, WOW! Breathtaking❤️

name: Michael
text: Hosts provide a detailed and helpful guide. Spacious, clean AirBnB with beautiful views. We really enjoyed it and would stay here again.

name: Claire
text: This is our second time staying at Jonathan's place and we had a great time again! The home is beautiful and well stocked and you can't beat the view. Would love to come back!

name: Rabindra
text: We had a fabulous time!!! We loved how you thought about all the details and made our stay memorable. Thank you.

name: Mosaab
text: Had a blast at Jonathan's place. House was awesome with gorgeous mountain views and lots of games and other things to do. The community store was a 5 minute drive whenever we needed to purchase anything. The lake was also a very close drive and a great time.

name: Lior
text: Absolutely amazing stay at Jonathan's house! The home is stunning, nestled in a breathtaking views. Every detail has been thoughtfully prepared: the kitchen is stocked better than any Airbnb we've ever stayed in everything you could need and more. The house was spotless, incredibly comfortable, and filled with games in every corner made it perfect for relaxing and spending time together. You can really feel the care put into this place. Highly recommend, and we can't wait to come back!

name: Erin
text: Beautiful home! We had a wonderful time

name: Jasjot
text: Stunning home & amazing host! My family and I wanted a little getaway from the city for my mom's 60th and we all absolutely loved the views.

name: Shelby
text: Great stay! Beautiful cabin, cozy, and lots to do! Hosts were helpful with recommendations during our stay.We plan to visit again in the future!

name: Angela
text: Wow!! Your home is beautiful. Our family always had something to do. The kitchen was fabulous, it had everything we needed to cook our meals. The beds were so comfortable. We had to contact the owner a few times and he was very fast to respond and take care of us. I highly recommend staying in the home. You will not regret it!

name: Jennifer
text: We had a wonder stay here. The view was stunning, very peaceful. The beds and linens were super comfy. Our family enjoyed the games and pool table also.

name: Elijah
text: Beautiful place for a relaxing weekend. Lots of kitchen amenities for those who are looking to do some cooking. Plenty of privacy and scenic views. Jonathan is very helpful and responsive. Highly recommend.

name: Sofia
text: This was an amazing experience! Jonathan is extremely proactive and gave us all the info we needed about the house and amenities before we even arrived. The house is stunning and the views are wonderful. I highly recommended staying here and would love to come again!

name: Eric
text: Jonathan's place was ideal for our family vacation. Many of us like to cook, so the large, well equipped kitchen was great. Bathrooms were very clean and generously supplied with nice towels. Wooded location was peaceful and joy to experience from the multiple decks looking out over the valley. The online house/location guide is very thorough

name: Rain
text: This house was perfect for our writing retreat! Beautiful views, well-equipped kitchen, cozy living space + rooms. Highly recommend.

name: Corey
text: Five Stars—Absolutely Stunning Stay!We had an incredible experience at 133 Aspen Way. The views from the property are absolutely magnificent—every morning and evening was a treat for the eyes. The beds were super comfortable, ensuring we got a great night's rest every day. The amenities were top of the line and exceeded our expectations in every way.This is by far the nicest Airbnb we've ever stayed in. If you're visiting this area, you truly couldn't find a nicer place to stay. Highly recommend to anyone looking for comfort, beauty, and luxury all in one. Truly an awesome Airbnb—we can't wait to return!

name: Nicole
text: Jonathan's place is amazing! The views are breathtaking and the big windows allow you to always take in the view! The kitchen is amazing to cook in and the fire is a nice touch. We felt at home and had such a good trip. Would recommend!

name: Steve & Shannon
text: The place is very comfortable, the view is spectacular and the owner was great to work with! It is not a drawback, but it's important to know that it has lots of steps, so be cognizant of that, we had two sets of grandparents and they did fine, but it was a lot for the elderly. I would and do recommend this place, it worked perfect for the JMU graduation even though it's fair from campus. It's a great home, I loved how unique and the amount of available supplies was greatly appreciated!

name: Nick
text: Beautiful house! great for large groups. it is a little remote so make sure to bring everything you'll need, but we had a fantastic time and the hosts were very accommodating and helpful!

name: Mary
text: Beautiful, quiet, clean, comfortable

name: Ashley
text: Great stay with a group of friends! The views were amazing, can't imagine what it'd be like in the fall. The fully stocked kitchen made it very easy to cook and there were instructions for all the appliances. Only thing to note was that sound travels quite a bit due to the layout of the home, so it could be tough for light sleepers. However, earplugs were provided which was a nice touch! An amazing weekend overall!!

name: Scott
text: Had a great time. The home was exactly as described. The kitchen was nicely stocked with everything for preparing meals including seasonings , oil etc. The coffee area was nicely supplied and all worked well. The bedrooms were comfortable and the bathrooms were also nicely stocked. The common areas were perfect size for family gatherings, games etc. The porch over looking the valley had a beautiful view with nice furniture. Would definitely stay there again.

name: David
text: Beautiful home with all the listed amenities. Jonathan was great about communicating even when there was a slight mishap. I appreciated his help and the issue was solved within hours. Would highly recommend.

name: Nandini
text: We had an amazing stay at the house. The views were beautiful and we loved doing the hikes in the area esp the old rag. We also enjoyed Lake Laura and Luray Caverns. The house was great. All the amenities were there, the host was very helpful and very quick to respond in case of any questions. The house is beautiful, furnished and very clean. we did not need to carry anything with us except food and drinks. We are planning to go back maybe in the fall. The views are just gorgeous.

name: Katie
text: This place was beautiful. Looking out the windows to the fantastic and calming Mountain View's was just what the doctor ordered. We had 9 adults and this house was plenty big. The kitchen is particularly spacious and very well stocked. Jonathan was extremely responsive and allowed some flexibility when it came to timing which helped us out tremendously. ONE thing: I would not want to drive here in snow or darkness. Overall, I would absolutely recommend this place.

name: Michelle
text: This place was amazing. We took a family trip with another family to Bryce to go skiing and tubing. The house is 5 mins away and although the road there is a little windy the house sits on top of a beautiful hill with a great view. You can tell they really put time and effort into this rental and tried to make it special. The linens and beds were white, clean, and super comfy. The pillows were plush and felt new. The house was clean and everything well thought out with even hotel like amenities. The kids loved the swinging chairs, pool table, and spent too much time in the golf game. The kitchen had everything we needed and great appliances like all clad! Even vacuuming the house was way with great vacuums that worked well. The house is unique and spacious and the views are super nice. We enjoyed the stay and the hosts were nice and very responsive!

name: Bryant
text: Great place with a great view

name: Melissa
text: This was an awesome location and house for a girls getaway. The house is very conducive to a large group, with lots of space to spread out. Everything was as described in pictures and in listing, but being there was a whole different thing! Highlights include the pool table, comfortable beds, super cozy spots to read or watch tv, the wonderful hanging chairs, and spectacular view! We would absolutely return and encourage anyone to stay here! As many of us on the trip are moms, we appreciated the baby gate hook ups, portable crib, toys/games, and children's tableware were found here.

name: Mary
text: Jonathan and Anna's Airbnb in Basye is beautiful with phenomenal views and comfortable in every aspect. All the personal touches made us feel at home— from the phone charger in each room, the toiletries provided, the kitchen has nearly all necessities and a fantastic coffee and espresso maker, spices, etc. our family enjoyed every nook of the home including the duel sided wood burning fire place 🔥, chair swings for reading and taking in the mountain view, and pool table. Thank you for creating a thoughtful, warm, and modern home with phenomenal views! Oh and board game selection is outstanding!!!We'll definitely stay again!

name: Lisa
text: The photos and description accurately depict Jonathan's lovely home. It is truly a treasure! The views are magnificent. For those in our family who chose to ski, the slopes were very convenient. Some of us simply enjoyed several areas of this beautiful mountain escape to sip our favorite beverage- and "catch up". The coffee bar set-up was great! The house was thoughtfully and very tastefully designed and decorated. We're already dreaming of our next visit! We can't imagine staying anywhere else as we felt so relaxed- so " at home". Jonathan is a gracious host who clearly cares about offering an exceptional vacation experience for his guests.

name: Mark
text: We had an amazing stay at this beautiful home! The house was absolutely wonderful—clean, spacious, and perfectly equipped for our group. The host was incredibly communicative, making the entire process seamless and stress-free. The location couldn't have been better—it's in a fantastic area, just a quick 5-minute drive to skiing, which made our trip so convenient and enjoyable. We loved everything about our stay and would highly recommend this place to anyone. Thank you for such a memorable experience!

name: Julie
text: The house was gorgeous and had every amenity and item we needed, even a toy basket for the dogs! The views were outstanding and we were very comfortable in the living spaces; the bedding is wonderful, SUPER soft and warm. We loved the proximity to Bryce Resort, too!

name: Naomi
text: This place was amazing and our stay was even better. It's situated right next to ski slopes and in the mountains, so there's tons of beautiful views all around. Most importantly the host was timely in their responses and super accommodating. I would highly recommend them to anyone considering a stay in the area

name: Ellen
text: Beautiful views and an amazing spot. We had a great time.

name: Ke-Nya
text: This house was beautiful! My husband and I had a great time. The view of the mountains was amazing!

name: Rachel
text: This was hands down the most thoughtful and well prepared AirBnB we have EVER stayed at. The house itself is stunning and huge. It looks exactly as pictured, and the views are incredible. It has everything you could possibly need--fully stocked kitchen with every appliance, spice, oil, coffee, foil, etc. Plenty of towels and linens. Dog bowls and toys, games and puzzles, ear plugs (didn't need them, it's very quiet), etc. They thought of everything. And the beds were super comfortable. Our group had the best time, and we would happily return!

name: Bobbi
text: This house is a hidden gem! Absolutely stunning and had everything you could need. I would recommend this place to anyone looking to escape to the mountains.

name: Cassie
text: What a gem!! We came here for our honeymoon and couldn't be happier. We were absolutely blown away by how beautiful the house was and that incredible view!! The pictures simply do not do this place justice.

name: Elizabeth
text: We came here for my daughter's 20th birthday. She wanted her 1st trip on her special day and Jonathan's place was in deed that special place. We loved that it was very organized and house was clean. The guide book was set up well and easy to follow. It looks exactly like the pictures too. Jonathan was very helpful and very responsive. I do highly recommend this place to anyone. I enjoyed the tub, the kitchen had everything, the fire pit but in and outside. Overall this was an amazing & enjoyable weekend trip for my daughter's friends & family. Will definitely come back again. Thank you Jonathan for allowing us to stay in your beatutiful lovely home.

name: Barbara
text: Jonathan's home was beautiful. Breathtaking views. Exactly as described. Felt right at home. Would highly recommend.

name: Nitin
text: Absolutely lovely house in a beautiful location. Felt very lucky to spend time here. Check-in was very easy. The house has amazing views with a little bit of something for everyone. We had two small kids and there was a crib and high-chair easily accessible. Everyone had their own space but also felt cozy. Can't say enough great things about this place and host!

name: Jessica
text: This home was absolutely gorgeous. In addition to all the thoughtful amenities (toiletries in the bathrooms, spices and coffee in the kitchen, etc) there were several little touches that show just how much this host cares about their listing. Curtains had little magnets to secure them and keep out the light, there were charges and earplugs at every bedside, and the guest info app was thoroughly updated and helpful. Staying here was a dream between the gorgeous home and the unforgettable views.

name: Brian
text: Great place with a beautiful view. We loved hanging out playing pool. Something for everyone in our group. Great stay.

name: Will
text: My wife and I loved our time at Jonathans‘s cabin. The views are unbelievable. The turnkey amenities were really appreciated from the coffee bar to the fresh towels. Washer and dryer and iron were a nice touch as well. Would definitely stay here again. The place appears to be dog friendly so if you are adverse to dog allergens would just make Jonathan aware prior to booking.

name: Wendy
text: Wow, what an absolute pleasure it was to stay in this gorgeous home! The million-dollar view over the valley made us feel like we were tucked up in a treehouse. The house was so unique - exactly like the photos - and had so many amenities that we felt right at home. I can't say enough about the well-stocked kitchen - we love to cook and there was nothing wanted for. We thoroughly enjoyed the peaceful setting, which made our business retreat extra special. Thank you for sharing your lovely home and for making our stay feel like home. The best rental we've had at Bryce by far!

name: Samantha
text: We loved our stay! It's a beautiful house with a gorgeous view, and a fully stocked kitchen so we were able to feel cozy and at home all weekend :) Also, lots of board games and the bedding was so soft!The only note we had was that there was a lot of dog hair on some of the furniture and blankets.We would definitely stay here again!

name: Brianna
text: We had a wonderful trip here to celebrate my husbands Birthday with friends. All elements of the accommodation from the interior architectural design, well appointed amenities, stunning views, and the hospitality of Jonathan were all phenomenal. We especially appreciated the thoughtful touches for kids and pets. It was a luxurious getaway surrounded by nature. We would definitely go back to visit!

name: Kurt
text: Beautiful views and felt right at home! The house was really nice and fully stocked. We had such a relaxing weekend and the kids as well as the adults had plenty of entertainment provided at the house. Planning on returning in the future!

name: Jocelyn
text: Hands down the best airbnb we have ever stayed at. The kitchen alone was fully stocked with everything ! Made cooking very easy for our family. We hiked Tibbet knob and that was beautiful and not far from the house. Jonathan was a GREAT host!!! We would love to come back again. Thank you for a great house with great views for the week!

name: Jesse
text: Took my wife for a great birthday weekend of caverns, wineries, and hikes. But she and I, along with 4 other couples, enjoyed the time in this mountain home the best. What we loved:Practical kitchen stocked with all we needed to cook, grill, drink, and dine.Comfortable beds with soft sheets and cold A/C.Lovely views and breezes on the 3 levels of outside decks. Modern amenities and furniture, with a minimalist style. Easy to park and enter the home.Highly recommend. Everything was smooth. Don't forget to check out the Brewery, ice cream shop, mini golf, and farmer's market right at the bottom of the road!

name: Sara
text: My sisters and mom celebrated our sisters 40th here and it met what we were looking for. A place in the mountains that was nice and clean and very cute.

name: Edward
text: Very beautiful House and Surroundings. The views are outstanding. All items in kitchen / bathrooms / den were top notch. Very Modern. Lots of space for a number of guests.Draw-back is it is a very remote location. To go shopping, eat at a nice restaurant, etc. - need to travel a around half hour. They do have a community store (store at the gas station) which is good for miscellaneous needs, and they do have a couple of bar-restaurants (but not high level).There is a local lake that can swim at and rent canoes.Overall, was very happy with the house, the beautiful views and a general peaceful and scenic vacation.Jonathan was very responsive and pleasure to work with.

name: Anne
text: This was an excellent place to stay for a low-key, relaxing girls weekend. We spent a lot of time enjoying the beautiful view from the porch and dining room. The house is well-decorated, comfortable, clean, and the kitchen is extremely well stocked. The owners were responsive and proactive in sending us information about the surrounding area. I would return without hesitation.

name: Fritz
text: The house was beautiful and very clean. It was nice to have a well-stocked kitchen with spices, napkins, paper towels etc. and not have to buy them or bring them from home for the trip. It was also great that the place was pet friendly. All in all, our family really enjoyed our stay!

name: Dave
text: Amazing place. Has everything you need.

name: Dan
text: Had a great time. Beautiful house with a beautiful view. Tons of extra amenities that made it stand out from other places I've been.

name: Millie
text: This place was wonderful and stocked with anything you would ever need! The view is spectacular and we can't wait to have a chance to go back.

name: Kelly
text: We had a wonderful family vacation in this home! I especially appreciated the consideration of small children and pets since we have a toddler and dog. The visitors guide was very helpful regarding recommendations and there are plenty of amenities. We'll definitely be coming back!

name: Douglas
text: Great getaway with the family. Plenty of space.

name: John
text: It is a place of unforgettable memories for a long time. With Jonathan's kind explanation and help, I am going back from this wonderful scenery. I hope our family will come back soon and have a great time again. I definitely recommend it to those who are tired or need a break from their daily lives.

name: Noriya
text: Excellent Airbnb. A well-stocked and clean cabin. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here!

name: Rebecca
text: Just as described - beautiful and clean - would absolutely return

name: Bobby
text: Absolutely beautiful!! The view, area, and everything was perfect. The house looks like the photos and has a enough amenities to feel at home/occupied if you'd like to stay in and also enough places close by to also get out for awhile. Great getaway space to free your mind and relax. I've stayed at many houses in this area and this is one of the nicest. Jonathan is also very responsive and did all the legwork to put together a great guide package that lets you know what to expect, things to do, how to use the amenities, and everything else you can think of. 10/10 would recommend. Enjoy!

name: Amy
text: This house stands out among the many rentals we've stayed at. The house is beautifully furnished (so many cozy nooks for reading!), and the view is great (from all of the many decks). If you plan to do much cooking, the kitchen is really well stocked - I think it would be easy to host an entire Thanksgiving dinner there. The bedrooms were also nicely furnished and very comfortable. And Jonathan was a great host. He provided a very detailed book of house tips and ideas for local hikes and restaurants. Highly recommend this mountain top vacation spot!

name: Leah
text: Was just looking for a place for myself and a group of friends to hang out and relax for a weekend away. Great find, beautiful place, a few nice restaurants/bars right at the bottom of the mountain…couldn't recommend this stay more.

name: Chris
text: Jonathan's home was everything that was pictured and described. The daytime and sunset views are stunning.Jonathan was super responsive both leading up to and during our stay. From the moment our reservation was made, we were provided link to their virtual guestbook which contained a wealth of information about the home and many of the areas surrounding restaurants and activities. A very nice touch! We did venture out to the Old Hill Cidery (Showalter's Orchard), which was really good, but we mostly stayed in and enjoyed all that their home had to offer; a great kitchen, spacious dining & seating areas, and plenty of entertainment spaces/activities.Would definitely recommend the stay/experience.

name: Sam
text: Fantastic host and great location. The home was very clean especially the bathrooms. Plenty of boardgames and activities within the house but they are all inside cabinets or otherwise neatly organized. The kitchen has everything that we need as a group of 8 who did quite a bit of cooking inside.Great view out of the balconies from each floor. The host has a very thorough guide to the various things within the house like the fireplace and golf arcade/pool table etc. Loved it and worth paying a little more for an ultra modern and spacious location in the hills.

name: Tiffany
text: Wow! This place was absolutely amazing! It was clean, had everything we needed, and was so close to the ski resort! I can't say enough good things about both the hosts and the location. We enjoyed the house thoroughly and plan on coming back many times in the future. We especially loved the layout of the house and the balcony with fire pit. It was also fantastic that it's dog friendly, and there were baby gates on all the stairs.

name: Manoj
text: We loved the place as soon as we entered. The place was spacious and very clean. It was booked for our ski trip which was very close to house. All the rooms were neat and clean and everyone enjoyed the stay. The house was full of amenities for children and adults to have fun. We would surely be back again.

name: ⁨Ashley M.⁩
text: Weekend Getaway! We thought the home was impressive - bedrooms are a little small but the time is spent in the core areas of the home, so it is fitting. The home is the BEST equipped home we have rented thus far, and we have rented a Bunch! So many thoughtful touches all around the home that make for a very enjoyable stay. The views are worth the booking alone - they are amazing! We arrived at night and to wake to that view was breathtaking!! What a great time! We thank the Host for being overly fast with their responses! We highly recommend this home for a weekend getaway!

name: Joon
text: This listing was the best Airbnb I've been to. The space was very open and modern with beautiful views and was stocked with everything I needed. The bathrooms and bedrooms were so clean and the beds were so comfortable. I liked how we were able to go from the living room, to the indoor fireplace to the dining room. Had a lot of fun at the basement too playing pool. Jonathan was very communicative and the guide was very helpful. 10/10!

name: Maggie
text: My staff and I came here for a weekend away and absolutely loved the space! We went skiing at the (very) nearby Bryce Resort but would've been just as happy to camp out in this home for the whole time. It was upscale, fully stocked, and just a terrific environment. I would come here again for sure:).

name: Sandra
text: amazing home with great amenities. kitchen was very well appointed to cover all cooking needs as well as pantry essentials(oil, spices, bags, aluminum foil...) , we really enjoyed the coffee station. wife enjoyed the lotions and soaps in the bathroom.

name: Kathy
text: My husband and I, along with 5 good friends, loved this house! The house is as beautiful as described and pictured on the website. Kitchen and bathrooms are well stocked. Bed linens are warm and cozy. The guest book is thorough and provides clear simple instructions. I only had 1 question and Jonathan responded within 10 seconds. We would love to stay here again on our next winter getaway.

name: Parnia
text: Jonathan's place was the perfect home for a friend's getaway weekend! Clean, stocked with essentials, and beautiful interior designing. He was also very communicative throughout the trip. Highly recommend.

name: Shannon
text: This was by far the best airbnb stays we have ever had and we have had some great experiences! The home is perfect for families who just want a nice getaway with space for everyone! We did enjoy one day of fun on the slopes but our favorite times were simply hanging at the house. We can't wait to come back again in the warmer months!

name: Rasha
text: I can't say enough great things about Jonathan and Anna and their place. The home was even more gorgeous in person (which is wild, given how amazing the photos are themselves). The home had everything we could possibly need AND MORE. The beds were so comfortable, I tried to find out what brand the mattress was so I could purchase one for myself. I've been using AirBnbs for 6 years now and this was by far my favorite home to stay in, that I'm eager to come back. The home was beautiful on its own, but Jonathan and Anna's responsiveness and genuine kindness was what took this place over the top for me. They went above and beyond to make sure I had the best birthday celebration ever. 10/10 highly recommend.

name: Marisol
text: Book it! The pictures are accurate, and the vibes of the house are immaculate. I traveled with a group of 7. We are a Black framily, and although we did not feel comfortable in the local area (Community Store, Copper Kettle, Food Lion, specific political flags...etc), the Airbnb was worth it. If you're staying for a while, do your grocery shopping and relax in the gorgeous house!

name: Jennifer
text: We had an amazing family Thanksgiving at this wonderful house. It had plenty of room and literally EVERYTHING we needed for a large dinner -- everything from a roasting pan to a high-quality toaster oven to vases for flowers. The views are amazing, and the house is so cozy and filled with great spaces to hang out as a whole group or in smaller groups. Beds are comfortable and communication with the host was fabulous. All in all, one of the best rental houses we have stayed at, and we would definitely return!

name: Sean
text: Perfect place for a fall getaway! My family really enjoyed the stay and agree that this is one of the best vacation homes we've stayed. It was very clean and had everything we could think of. Jonathan was very responsive and considerate. We'd love to come back.

name: Deepen
text: The house/location are incredible, but we did have an issue with the hot water. We ran out of hot water for a while and Jonathan was very responsive in helping get it fixed by telling us how to reset the power. It seems like the hot water runs out (even when functioning normally) given there's up to 10 people staying at the house, so that was the only flaw. Otherwise, the beds are unusually comfortable, the kitchen was so well stocked, and the place was very clean. I recommend staying here.

name: Tia
text: Jonathan was a fabulous host and they made the extra effort to make the stay feel special. We came as a group of 8 to celebrate my husband's 50th birthday and it was absolutely perfect. Everyone was happy, comfortable, and relaxed in this beautiful home. The deck and the view was my favorite part, but I really appreciated the beautiful modern kitchen since I was doing all the cooking. My sons would say their favorite part was the billiard table and the golf video game. I only wish we had another night!

name: Dora
text: This place is truly magnificent. Jonathan and Anna have created a space that is beautiful, welcoming, and tranquil. The attention to detail and guide they've created shows how much they care about ensuring their guests have the best experience possible. We had an amazing time! Thank you and hope to be back soon.

name: Yumhee
text: Our family had a lovely stay at Jonathon's place for a fall getaway. The views are incredible and the house is well stocked with all kitchen and bathroom needs and a fun pool play area at the bottom. The only thing I didn't consider were the stairs for my older mother and my two year old toddler - but that is on us as the pictures clearly show how many stairs there are — they even had baby gates which was very helpful. All in all, it was a great and fun stay, with great activities to do nearby — we stopped by lake Laura and got custard and my husband was able to do some mountain biking. Thank you for a great stay!

name: Andreas
text: Perfect place to stay. You won't miss anything.

name: Rebecca
text: This home was an absolutely perfect spot for our bookclub retreat! The house was gorgeous with stunning views, beautifully and thoughtfully decorated with all necessary amenities and easily accommodated our group of 8 adults.

name: Lauren
text: Jonathan is a very thoughtful host and truly thought of everything. You'll have everything you need for your stay. The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful, the views are incredible, and the beds are comfy. My favorite thing in the house was the swinging chair. Such a cozy spot to curl up with a book by the fire.

name: Casey
text: A well updated, spacious, welcoming, and fun house with plenty of room for activities and an absolutely gorgeous view. Hosted a relaxing and enjoyable bachelor weekend with 8 friends, everyone had their own bed and plenty of bathroom space for each person. The amenities were all top notch, the kitchen fully stocked with everything you could possibly need and the house allowed for everyone to hang out together or split off and do your own thing. Jonathan was responsive and his guestbook had recommendations and instructions for everything you could possibly need. The entire group agreed this was the nicest and best Airbnb they'd ever stayed at!

name: Julia
text: The the most incredible Airbnb we have ever stayed at. It is one of a kind and worth experiencing if you can !! Stocked with all you need and breathtaking views the details in this house are unbelievable!

name: Shratha
text: It was a very peaceful stay. We didn't do anything but enjoy the house and it's views.

name: Molly
text: The house was perfect for a weekend getaway! Beautiful views, super clean, and stocked with everything we could've ever needed throughout the weekend. Jonathan was proactive and quick to respond. We had an awesome weekend there and would definitely go back!!

name: John
text: our stay was fantastic, the home was everything I expected and more. we didn't need anything more then what was already there.

name: Aalap
text: Great stay. The house was beautiful and had all of the necessities taken care of. Great hosts.

name: Pam
text: We loved this house! It was as beautiful as pictured...so well decorated, everything so clean, comfy beds, great views, very well appointed. There were so many thoughtful touches...from coffee beans and grinder to high quality soaps and bar accessories....Tit made us really feel at home! This is the nicest Airbnb I've stayed in and I would highly recommend it. Jonathan was extremely responsive to any questions. We loved the area...went hiking, golfing, to Lake Laura and to the caves. Restaurant options are limited in the area, but that was fine for us since we like to cook and the kitchen was great. There wasn't a single piece of cookware or utensil that wasn't provided and everything was well organized. I would highly recommend this property!!

name: Julie
text: Hands down the best AirBNB we've ever stayed in - beautiful view, very quiet and secluded, huge kitchen stocked with literally everything, great layout with plenty of bedrooms and bathrooms. Nothing was missing. We would love to come again!

name: Silvia
text: Beautiful place in beautiful condition with so many different areas in the house to hang out, so you really never get bored of it! The place was stocked with everything from toiletries to coffee to a toolbox. Jonathan was also super responsive and friendly. We'd love to come back in the winter!

name: Don
text: Beautiful and peaceful place! I really enjoyed the guidebook provided that answered every question we had. Thank you for sharing your home with us, can't wait to return.

name: Kristine
text: I was blown away by the house! We kept saying all weekend how fantastic the house was. True to photos, accurate descriptions, and a view that kept us captivated throughout our stay. The property was well-appointed with thoughtful touches that made our stay feel easy and cosy (whereas some other Airbnbs can feel sterile or barren). There was also a stellar mix of hang-out spaces, indoors and outdoors. We were only 6 people but could see how this would work well even for a larger group.The hosts provided a very helpful guide for how to best enjoy the home. They were very proactive in messaging on our arrival to make sure we had our check-in instructions. I expect they'd be very responsive if we had any issues (but we didn't). Check-out was easy and the "before leaving" tasks were exceptionally reasonable.Overall: a truly memorable experience, a fantastic location, and the kind of privacy and tranquility that we city-dwellers rarely get. We hope to visit again in the future. Book now!

name: Christy
text: So hard to put into words how incredible Johnathan's place is. They thought of everything when designing it, even down to the little details of makeup removers and coffee beans for espresso. You will be blown away by the space and never want to leave. 10 out of 10 would recommend to anyone and already we are planning our next stay!

name: Dina
text: This is a gorgeous home tucked away in a beautiful mountain town. Jonathan and Anna offer so many amenities--pool table, puzzles, grill, firepit, real fire place, tons of kitchen appliances not generally found in an AirBNB, lovely towels and linens--all topnotch and it makes it a great house to just stay and enjoy those you love. We spent so much time outside, enjoying the view and listening to nature. It was a terrific place to stay. Don't hesitate to rent from this couple!

name: Kevin
text: Who doesn't enjoy being spoiled? This is the place for you. Large spacious beautiful home. Multiple places to congregate or be alone. Beautiful surroundings, decks galore and very cozy. The tlc from coffee bar, spices, pots and pans, great beds, etc..Would definitely stay there again. Thanks Jonathan!!

name: Arpan
text: Amazing place to relax after some long hikes. Jonathan and Anne were super helpful and would definitely book again!

name: Kathy
text: Perfect get away in luxury accommodations. Love the wood indoor fireplace and outdoor gas fireplace. Had no problems with getting a great fire going indoors but my husband knows what he is doing in that regard. Fully stocked modern kitchen!! Lots of glassware! Linens and bedding perfect. 3 great decks. No backyard but not necessary. Walked up the street to top of ski lift that was in use for mountain biking. Great spot don't hesitate to take advantage of this lovely home.

name: Chloe
text: This was the nicest Airbnb we have ever stayed in. The house was spacious, great beds, bedding and bedrooms, modern bathrooms, super well equipped. We enjoyed the fireplace in the living room on colder nights, and the one on the deck in the evening enjoying a truly spectacular view. I would give more than five stars if I could and can't wait to be back! Thanks so much to the hosts for creating such a wonderfully comfortable home in the mountains.

name: Elizabeth
text: What an incredible home! Even more impressive than the pictures. Our group ranged from 9 months old to 78 years old and the house was perfect for everyone. The interior decorating is incredibly beautiful- a luxurious and modern take on the mountain cabin. The house is fully stocked (kitchen, baby/kid, safety and dog gear), which was much appreciated. Fabulous location- we were very close to many hiking trails and vineyards. Jonathan was very hospitable and the house manual was a super awesome resource.

name: Nikki
text: This place was as expected and more. The location and view looked like it was from a postcard. Stayed here to celebrate my mother's 50th birthday with family. There was enough space for us all and my family members were impressed with all the thoughtful amenities, decor, and entertainment. They made it so you don't need to leave the house unless you want to. There is a beautiful fireplace however the fire logs are not provided, I brought 3 logs but it wasn't enough to enjoy the fireplace on both days during our stay so make sure you bring enough! Overall, 5 star stay and I can't wait to return.

name: Allison
text: Amazing view! There was plenty of room for our big family and 2 dogs, and the house was super clean and smelled nice. A perfect, peaceful weekend!

name: Jennie
text: Beautiful house with spectacular view. Very clean and thoughtful amenities along with friendly quick responses. Jonathan and Anna was great and they cares everything that we needed it. Our family had a great time and I highly recommend this awesome host and beautiful house to everyone!

name: Jeffrey
text: This house was a wonderful setting for a small reunion with friends. Terrific space, lots of amenities, great kitchen (with coffee!) and an amazing view. Hosts were incredibly kind and gracious. Highly recommend.

name: Brian
text: Our family of 8 really enjoyed our stay. The view was beautiful and we appreciated the thoughtful details associated with the Airbnb. It's very well maintained and would strongly recommend it. We look forward to staying again in the future!

name: Delaney
text: Amazing experience!!!

name: Shruti
text: We were hosting our wedding in Timberville, and found 3 AirBnBs for us and our family members in nearby Basye. Jonathan's place was so stunning that my family would not stop telling us that multiple times a day. It is amply stocked, comfortable, clean, beautifully laid out, full of natural light, and the multilevel space downstairs can be used in many ways! We had a wonderful time the first night with family and girlfriends, as I got my henna done. And the second afternoon, as my girlfriends and I rehearsed our dances. Hubby and I took the room with the bathtub, king bed, and private balcony, which was amazing to soothe our sore selves and get at least a few moments of private time. My dad and his brother got together after a year, and were bonding over billiards, while my mum and aunts thoroughly enjoyed the kitchen space. Jonathan's communication is great, and he let us have a later checkout when our wedding coordinator messed up, so we had to spend hours on cleanup after our wedding

name: Jennifer
text: We had a such a wonderful visit at Jonathan's place. It truly had everything (and more) than we needed. It had a fully stocked kitchen (paper towels, dishwasher pods, trash bags - things you normally pack because you aren't sure) and even had extra toiletries in each bathroom! It's one of those places where you can just bring yourself and your clothes and not worry about anything else. The entire spaced matched the pictures perfectly and it just worked so well for our girl's weekend. Though the road was narrow and steep, it didn't really matter to us because we spent most of our time at the house. I would keep that in mind if you plan to go out and about often. However, I couldn't recommend this house enough and will definitely keep it in mind for other trips!

name: Soy
text: The house was great for our family vacation and Jonathan was a great host. Very responsive and helpful whenever we had a question. Bryce is about a 5 minute drive or short walk for ski in/out - to a blue slope (advanced). The beds were comfortable and the house had so many games and other features to keep us all entertained. The kitchen was also fully equipped which was very nice.

name: Tara
text: Jonathan's home was beautiful and so well stocked! It was truly one of the best AirBnB experiences I have had. The home is within walking distance to a run at Bryce resort, which worked well for those in our group that were skiing and snowboarding. Even if you're not partaking in the Bryce winter activities, the home is a welcome retreat for all - stunning views, beautiful decor and plenty of spaces to read, play a game or just take in the surroundings.

name: Chris
text: Great place; lovely view and very convenient to Bryce. Would love to book again.

name: Deborah
text: Jonathan's place was beautiful!! Gorgeous mountain views through the wall-to-wall glass doors, nice modern decor, all the bathroom amenities you would need, wonderful bed linens, fully-stocked kitchen, tons of space, 3 minute drive to the Bryce ski resort. I could go on and on. For anyone bringing dogs though - the house is on a mountain so there is no flat grassy area for dogs to do their business - you have to walk them along the road. Our family had a great time and we wouldn't hesitate to visit again. Jonathan was so responsive, and he provides a link/app that goes over everything you would need to know during your stay.

name: Jennifer
text: This mountain retreat was exactly what my family and friends needed for the weekend. With Three adults and four children there was plenty of space to relax and have fun. Beautiful scenery, comfortable places to relax, everything we would need. Would highly recommend, and will definitely rebook.

name: Chi
text: Beautiful home with gorgeous views made for a perfect weekend getaway with a small group of friends. The house was well stocked with everything you could possibly need. Jonathan is responsive and also provides a detailed guidebook to make navigating check-in and your stay easy. I'd recommend and would stay again!

name: James
text: Our stay was amazing! This experience was a holiday gift to ourselves and our family ~ best Christmas present ever! Time is a precious commodity, and the memories created from being together at Jonathan's location will last far beyond any tangible gifts from a store! Phenomenal views, family and pet-friendly amenities, attention to detail, clean and spacious...the list of accolades is endless! We were not looking for a place that had a lot of "go-to" locations...we were looking to get away from the insanity of life...and Jonathan's home provided a moment of Zen!We were ever so grateful to have found such an incredible home that was also welcoming of our pets because they are an integral part of our family and the holiday would not have been the same without them! Thank you, Jonathan. HIGHLY recommend your Airbnb! Happy New Year!Jim and Audrey

name: Jemal
text: Hands down one of the best Airbnb experiences I've had. House was beautiful, fully equipped, and very comfortable.

name: Chad
text: We had an amazing stay at this cabin. So close to Bryce resort and the cabin is well stocked with anything you could need. My kids loved the pool table and Golden Tee. There were lots of cozy nooks to read a book by the fire. Fantastic views and great deck space. The beds were very comfortable and we appreciated the nice bath amenities.

name: Melanie
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Jonathan's place! He was so responsive and helpful. The house is beautiful, well-stocked, comfortable, and clean. We had our family Christmas celebration there! We cooked all our meals in the wonderful kitchen and loved the pool table, deck space, living room, and baby gates at the stairs! We highly recommend staying here!

name: CIndy
text: Perfection. This home is even better than expected; even the beautiful photos don't do it justice. The location and views are amazing, but the house is beyond. The kitchen and bathrooms in particular are modern, functional and beautifully appointed. The game room is a great bonus with the golf simulator and pool table, and the family room is cozy and comfy. All of the beds are super comfortable and the linens crisp but soft. The swinging hammock chairs with the killer views were in use constantly with our group - ages 3 to 93 ! And the dining area was spacious and lovely. You CAN NOT go wrong here. And the hosts are friendly and super responsive and informative if you need them! We had a blast!!

name: Nikhil
text: The hosts went above and beyond, the home was very comfortable and well stocked with all the essentials. It is a great staycation destination where you can disconnect, and enjoy the beautiful scenery and nature.

name: Candice
text: One of the best host I have encountered :)

name: Chris
text: Really a joy staying at this property - the place is exactly as charming and welcoming as in the pictures. We were there in November for a corporate retreat, and the first floor space with its open floor plan was perfect for 8 people to have enough space but also feel close to one another. High recommend this property!

name: Shane
text: House was awesome and hosts were great. Would stay again!

name: Amanda
text: We had a wonderful stay! Hosts were great, and the house really is fully stocked! So nice not to have to worry about bringing everything with you from home.

name: Susan
text: The house is very spacious. Jonathan is a great host. The view was spectacular in late October with the leaves changing colors. We had a splendid time and we highly recommend this place for others. We were a group of nine adults.

name: Christine
text: This was a perfect stay in the mountains!! Perfectly clean and 100% as advertised. The kitchen is fully stocked with every plate, pot, tool and utensil you could possibly need…even spices, coffee, sugar and condiments. My guys spent most of their time playing pool, Golden Tee and watching sports on the lower level. The view is absolutely gorgeous from every level. I think I need to buy some of those hanging chairs for home. We would happily stay again :)

name: Lauren
text: Amazing space with beautiful views! Fully stocked with everything you need for a great, relaxing stay! Check in/checkout was so easy! Jonathan was responsive and had a great guidebook of local activities. Would definitely recommend!

name: Tamera
text: Our annual couples trip was made even more special with this amazing home. The online description does not do it justice. The home is stocked with everything and there is amazing space. Once we checked in there was no reason to leave. Will definitely be returning to stay again.

name: Tracy
text: Our party of 5 adults had a wonderful, relaxing stay. The house is exactly as pictured and described in the listing. The view is magnificent. The hosts have thought of everything - the house is well stocked with any household item you could possibly need. They also have plenty of games for every age group. Thumbs up all the way around. We absolutely recommend this place!

name: Brian
text: Great views, lots of stairs but worth it. Very comfortable furnishings and bedding.

name: Sydney
text: We absolutely loved our stay at this gorgeous place and highly recommend! It was extremely well stocked with everything you'd need for a group getaway and we had no issues. Gorgeous views, very spacious, large kitchen space, awesome pool table, etc. Hosts were very responsive and got us all the info we needed prior to our stay.

name: Edward
text: What a fantastic stay. Jonathan was super attentive and communication was quick and timely. The property was super clean and had EVERYTHING you could want....plus so many things you were surprised and glad to find. Stars at night were lovely. Would definitely return and would recommend.

name: Leana
text: A beautiful house!! Pictures don't do it justice! Views we're incredible! The house itself was so nice and luxurious and the host is so attentive with so much attention to detail and fully stocked everything! The Xbox was amazing for the kids and we all loved the outdoor fire pit! Host was so quick to communicate to address minor issues in the house and seemed to truly care about making sure we had the most enjoyable experience! Would definitely recommend staying here.

name: Michael
text: Stunning view! Very clean and well appointed. Beautiful decor and well stocked with everything you'll need.

name: Sammy
text: Amazing property with amazing views. Jonathan and Ana we very responsive and attentive to everything we needed. You can tell that a lot of thought was put into making sure guests were as comfortable as possible from the finishes, amenities and detailed communication that was provided. My family and I absolutely enjoyed our stay and will be visiting again in the future.

name: Maura
text: This Airbnb was incredible! Exactly as pictured and described. Plenty of beds and bathrooms for a large group. The deck and scenery are spectacular. Extremely close to many activities include Bryce resort, trails, and wineries. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to our friends and family.

name: Berel
text: What an amazing house!The house has immaculate design and details everything we possibly wanted to feel comfortable and enjoy our stay. That goes without saying the most spectacular views in an absolutely breathtaking setting!Jonathan was very caring and extremely accommodating!Highly recommended to stay here!

name: Sakina
text: We loved our stay! The home and views were beautiful. Jonathan was very responsive and attempted to fix any problem we had.

name: Sun Y Gloria
text: We absolutely loved the house! It was spacious & beautiful & of course the views were absolutely spectacular. We could tell how amazing it would be to sit by the fire after a long day of skiing! (We went in summer)Jonathan is one of the kindest hosts you'll meet. He allowed us special accommodations for our family reunion (to celebrate my mom's 70th bday), and also sent us our daughter's hat (free of charge) that she left at the house after we checked out! We also appreciated all high quality kitchen ware (pots, pans & knives, rice cooker, serving ware, glassware, bar ware, etc), all the various spices & extra oil/necessities & all the little things, like jellies/honey & the great toiletry items in the bathrooms! So thoughtful, especially as we needed them! Our doggies also loved the bed, toys & items in the doggie basket!The basement games were awesome! We played for hours there.We visited Lake Laura, which was surprisingly clean. The kids loved swimming & paddle-boating & a little fishing over the days. It's $10/person for an all-day pass.The lights outside & on the deck were beautiful & twinkling! We could tell how much thought was put into the details of the house & the Guest guidebook. We hope to come back again, perhaps in the wintertime next time!! Thank you!!!! Show more

name: Nora
text: Beautiful. Highly recommend.

name: Gali
text: Hands down the most amazing airbnb we've ever stayed in. Super equipped, gorgeous, with breathtaking views, and for a very affordable price considering the level of accommodations.

name: Zhishui
text: Jonathan is extremely thoughtful and responsive, and this is by far our best experience on Airbnb! The place is spacious, with all kinds of amenities you would ever need for a vacation, and well thought out in every corner of the space. I was surprised that all the bedrooms had great views, and the mattresses were comfortable in all of the beds! Our only regret is that we should've booked a longer stay, we only booked 2 days but my entire family enjoyed every minute and don't want to even leave the house:)! Definitely worth it and will come back again!

name: Lauren
text: Great experience staying at this place and lovely view. Owners were hospitable and responsive. Highly recommend!

name: Zach
text: This home is perfect. My wife and I have lived full time on Airbnb over the last year and a half and have stayed in over 60 places…this home is at the top of our list! Jonathan has thought of everything — appliances are high end, the place is fully stocked, and the amenities (like board games, fire pit, swings, etc.) we're top notch. We can't wait to be back!

name: Eman
text: Place is epic

name: Jonell
text: Awsome location, great view, had everything we needed and was immaculate! Excactly as advertised. Great hosts!Only thing we can add is that parking is in the street. May have missed this info, as they did detail everything which was great. We had 3 cars and fit fine with ample space for cars to drive by. Location is very quiet, with very little to no traffic. Fantastic trip! Thank you for making our family reunion an awsome trip.

name: Adeel
text: We had an amazing time at Jonathan's place. Everything was in immaculate condition and clean. Jonathan was super easy to reach with any questions we had. Everything you could possibly need is provided.

name: Rachel
text: Perfect place to stay for a mountain getaway in Virginia! The house was laid out perfectly for our group of 10. Very spacious, super clean, and stocked with everything you could possibly need (especially in the kitchen!). The views are beautiful - we spent lots of time hanging out on the deck - and the location is great for a day trip to Shenandoah National Park. We also enjoyed hanging out at Lake Laura (5 min drive away) where they have kayak, paddle boards, and pedal boat rentals. Book now, you won't be disappointed!

name: Chris
text: The house is beautiful! Very spacious and the view is fantastic! Highly recommend checking it out.

name: Julia
text: We had the most amazing time! The house is absolutely perfect. So many incredibly thoughtful touches. Like others have said, the store selection in town is a bit lacking, so pack a full cooler and enjoy. The view alone is worth the money! The beds were so comfortable and the kitchen was fully stocked. Jonathan has thought of everything. Parking is a little tricky if you have more than one large car/truck. However, at the end of the road there is a cul-de-sac. I'm sure you could park down there if need be. Overall, amazing stay. We hope to be back soon! Thank you!

name: Helen
text: This was the perfect place for my family's summer weekend getaway. All the amenities were spectacular: the views, the astonishingly kitted-out kitchen, the comfortable and stylish furnishings, the abundance of games and activities for kids, adults, and dogs! The nine of us made some great memories during our stay. It only took about seven minutes to drive down the mountain to the lake, where we went hiking, fishing, and paddling. We also visited a nearby winery and brewery only 20 minutes drive away. We found a disc golf course and mountain biking trails just steps away from the house. This place has it all, and we would absolutely stay here again.

name: Russ And Ann
text: this house is perfect for a family group with plenty of bath and sleeping spaces. there are extras of tasteful furnishings, coffee, espresso, etc. the decks provide an incredible view of a mountain ridge into West Virginia.the Wednesday Farmers Market is small, but provides everything you would expect from a mid size market.lake Laura, nearby, is lovely with kayak/ canoe rentals.

name: Omega
text: My husband, friends and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The cabin was absolutely gorgeous, very clean, spacious, and had an amazing view. Jonathan was very courteous. He always responded within minutes to answer any questions we had and checked in often to make sure everything was going well. We are looking forward to staying at the cabin again soon!

name: Rachel
text: We were shocked to see that this place was even more beautiful in person! The view is spectacular. You won't be disappointed! Jonathan is a great host who communicates well and makes sure you have all the information you need. We would happily recommend this property to anyone looking for a beautiful, comfortable place to relax and enjoy peaceful surroundings in nature

name: Claire
text: Jonathan was an excellent host! The guidebook provided before check in was so thorough and helpful and the standard amenities he included for his guests went above and beyond. The home itself is beautiful and nothing beats that view! We had a great time and will definitely be back!

name: Alex
text: This space is STUNNING!! It's even more beautiful than the pictures and it's such an amazing size! The hosts think of everything you could need, they have put so much thought and detail into this house. The home is stocked perfectly! The linens were amazing as was the bed. I really can't say enough things about this amazing space. The views are absolutely breathtaking and the hosts are great too!! Highly highly recommend!

name: Rashidah
text: House is gorgeous. View can't be beat. True peace and serenity. Kitchen was well-stocked with nearly everything you could think of. We also enjoyed the speaker—it enabled us to add a soundtrack to a really beautiful weekend at this beautiful home.

name: Andy
text: Jonathan's property is one of the best properties we've stayed in the Shenandoah area. His communication and information pre-check in is next to perfection. The house has great street parking right outside the front door. I've stayed at a few properties that have super steep driveways and I was happy this one wasn't one. Inside the house it's as beautiful as it is spacious. The home is also one of the most well stocked homes we've ever stayed. From the coffee to all the spices you need to cook with. The bedrooms were super comfortable fromThe beds to the bedsheets. The bathrooms all had plenty of soap and shampoo. We had 9 people and the house never felt small. We moved the kids room and now all the kids could enjoy sleeping together. The basement was a perfect entertainment level with the pool table and the golden tee arcade. There were also a ton of board games and never a shortage of things to do. The views were wonderful for sunsets and the main reason we picked Jonathan's property.

name: David
text: We really enjoyed our stay at Jonathan's house. It was everything we were expecting based on the pictures and more. When you walk into the house it is stunning. He has done a really wonderful job with the remodeling. The views off one of the the 3 back porches are amazing. The game room was one of the highlights of the house for us and we spent a lot of time there playing pool, Golden Tee Golf all while watching sports on the large TV. There are lots of trails to go hiking on in the area and if you are into mountain biking, the ski resort is just around the corner and they do mountain biking on the trails during the off-season, using the lift to take the bikers to the top. We were also able to get in a round of golf at the nice course at the resort as well.

name: Logan
text: We stayed a couple of nights and had a really great experience. The views are truly amazing - just hanging out and enjoying sunrise and sunsets from the deck make this place worth it. But we appreciated more than anything else how quick and responsive Jonathan was leading up to and throughout the stay. Made the whole stay really straightforward and we were able to chill out and relax as much as possible. We are looking forward to staying again in the winter to take advantage of the easy access to the ski resort at the end of the street. Glad we got a chance to stay here and explore the area.

name: Adam
text: This is the perfect escape into the mountains. Check in was seamless, Jonathan was easily accessible, and then there's the house. This modern, beautifully decorated, 3 story home provides a comfortable, sleek aesthetic. Every level has a different view of the gorgeous mountains that meet the changing skyline. No need to overpack as they provide everything from an array of spices for cooking to the toothpaste you always forget. I would recommend bringing your own food to cook in the immaculate kitchen or on the convenient grill. Thanks Jonathan for a delightful stay.

name: Sebastian
text: This is what the Airbnb experience aspires to be. This house is tremendous. Eight of us were supremely comfortable, and the views, amenities, communication, and swinging egg chairs were real highlights. I can't recommend this place enough, and Jonathan deserves special mention as thoughtful (the best-prepped guidebook I've ever seen), communicative (responses within minutes every time), and attentive to detail (you can tell a *lot* of time and effort went into this place, and it really shows)

name: Jason
text: Excellent place to stay. Family friendly. Beautiful views. Newly renovated, clean. Tons of games and entertainment. Four seasons. Host was available immediately for questions. Highly recommend.

name: Sheila
text: The place is pretty as the pictures. From the first step inside of the house to your last minute you will have a blast. The view from the kitchen the outdoor space ,the bar the fireplace and entertainment room. Use the speaker and play your favorite music while making your cappuccino on their coffee station.I love to cook and the kitchen has everything you can wish for to cook a great meal.The bathrooms are well equipped ,bedrooms with beautiful views. TVs the mattress are incredible. This house is made to relax and have a good time inside. The only worry is that you won't want to leave.

name: Susan
text: A beautiful, incredibly-appointed home - we had a brief stay and wish it could have been longer! The house is lovely inside and the rooms are well-decorated, cozy, and clean. Jonathan was incredibly communicative throughout our stay we couldn't have been happier. We'll be back again!

name: Aimee
text: A fantastic spot for our small extended family to gather! We loved the views, fire table, cooking together in the well-stocked kitchen, playing games at the large dining table, and the amazing kid's bunk room for an extended sleepover for the cousins! Such a unique house. Lots of rain and clouds for our stay, but no one seemed to mind playing the tons of games provided at the house. Everyone slept well in the comfortable beds. Jonathan was extremely responsive to our needs and flexible with a few special requests. The house comes with it's own guidebook for any questions that arise. Highly recommend!

name: Sara
text: We rented this cabin with friends for my fiancé's 30th birthday and absolutely adored it! We already are planning to come back. Amazing space and view!

name: Portia
text: It's hard to believe but, the pictures don't even do the house justice. Don't think twice. Book this stay!!! It's so beautiful and has so many things to do right at the house that you may not even want to leave your entire stay! They have card games, board games and more! Not to mention the views!!! The even provide some throws! I do recommend getting groceries somewhere other than the general store because everything in there is marked up to twice the normal prices if not more. (Thankfully, we brought a cooler full of stuff from home). But, the store does have a good variety of items! The trails leaving Wolf Gap recreational area are some of the closest to the house so we visited and it was 100% worth it. The views are beautiful off of Big Schloss trail. The roads are skinny and have a lot of twist and turns and people do speed a bit going up that direction and none of us had cell phone signal until we reached the campground but thankfully if you set your gps before you leave on Apple Maps it seems to stay up to date won't accurate directions even without signal! The first bit of the hike is a bit intense and I wouldn't recommend for young children or small dogs. But, after the steep incline it gets way easier! If you've read this far then, you're thinking twice and you should once again BOOK THIS STAY!! Show more

name: Itamar
text: Excellent communication from the start, we had a great time, the view is incredibly beautiful, we had a wonderful stay if enchanted and the attentions are great Translated  Show original

name: Brieanna
text: My family and I had such an incredible stay!! This was truly the best Airbnb experience I have had so far. Jonathan was hospitable and communicative. We are beyond grateful for how accommodating he was. The house is extremely comfortable and everything was clean! All of the linens and towels were fresh. We really enjoyed how well stocked the kitchen was. We loved using the espresso machine and sitting on the swings in the morning, admiring the great view! There are lots of board games and a pool table. My family had the best time sitting around the fire, listening to music and drinking wine. Jonathan had the best recommendations. We went to Muse Vineyards, hiked Tibbet Knob Trail, and enjoyed lunch at The Woodstock Cafe! I could not recommend this Airbnb enough. We hope to visit again soon!

name: Rangin
text: The pictures do not do this house justice at all! I had high expectations before going and when I got there, this house exceeded my expectations! All of my friends loved it and I was the best birthday trip ever! Everyone asked me to send them the link! The views were AMAZING! The kitchen was completely stocked with everything we needed and so much more! Honestly wish I could give it more than 5 stars, also on top of that Jonathan was an AMAZING host! He replied to all messages within 5 minutes! Seriously, don't let this house go, book it!!

name: Rebecca
text: This house is amazing in every way! We were so impressed with the thoughtful touches around the house, it is so well equipped as well as having amazing views. We hope to return very soon.

name: Emma
text: We had a great time and this is such a great house! The room set up is perfect (bunk bed room is adorable, and very functional) and the owners were incredibly kind and super attentive. They have child proof gates at all entry ways to stair cases which is nice if you have little ones running around. House is fully stocked in general, and for cooking - they had everything we needed and more, including spices. Downstairs rec room (with pool table and Golden Tee was also a great set-up). Last - the porches are awesome and the house has such a beautiful view! Thanks again for a great stay! Would love to come again!

name: Roopa
text: This is may be the best house in Basye. Clean, modern, close to everything, and wonderful hosts. Jonathan was quick to respond and really thought if everything for his guests' comfort. We hope to be back!

name: Shabih
