text: This property was extremely well supplied and very clean, easily the best Airbnb experience I have had yet. The owner was extremely quick to respond to any inquiry, and the property had everything you need for a great stay.

name: Nicholas
text: This place is stocked with everything you could ever want. Beautiful location.

name: Binita
text: Do not think twice !! Just get this place for your getaway. Amazing view, great space with plenty of amenities and great host

name: Surbhi
text: Great place. Great view. Hosts thought of providing everything! Loved our stay..

name: Adam
text: Great house with fantastic views. Everything was as described in the listing and we had a great time.

name: Christina
text: The house is lovely. The hosts thought of everything you could possibly need during your stay (fully stocked kitchen, fire wood, games, a speaker). The view is incredible and there's so much to do. I would definitely book again.

name: Kevin
text: The house was amazing and Jonathan was a great host. The house was stocked with every possible amenity, Jonathan and his wife went above and beyond for our enjoyment. Thanks again!

name: Cassie
text: This house is absolutely - rad! My husband and I booked it last minute for a birthday get away and this home and view did not disappoint. This home is immaculately decorated and the attention to detail makes the home extra special. We adored the hanging/swing chairs in the living room. Nothing better than sitting on a swing and looking at an amazing view. I also really appreciated the quality of the home - the beds were outrageously comfortable and the master bathroom has a spa-like quality. The owners are extremely easy to get a hold of and very considerate- they left a birthday card and a bottle of champagne for my birthday. Just delightful. Highly recommend. 👌 One note though is that grocery stores are a bit far, so I'd recommend stocking up before you come to the house. The closest full store is a food lion about 20-30 min away.

name: Karin
text: The house was perfect for a work retreat. Lots of space to spread out between groups, the internet worked great, and the TV was easy to connect presentations to via hdmi. Kitchen was stocked and the view was gorgeous.In winter if there has been snow, AWD or 4WD is likely needed to get to the house without white knuckles. There was substantial ice on some roads in the HOA when we arrived and a 2WD Ram truck was dicey. Subaru AWD was totally fine.

name: Eric
text: The house is big, clean, well-stocked, and a great base for skiing. Our group of two families with young kids had a fantastic time.

name: Karen
text: Beginning with the online house manual and personal check-ins from the host to the well-appointed kitchen with every tool and utensil one can think of, and ending with the cozy bedding and convenient bedside charging pads, this Airbnb rates as one of the best 5-star stays we've ever had. The place was sparkling clean when we arrived, and the hosts sent a thoughtful note to ensure we were settling in. Check in and communication were top notch. The online house manual is the best I've ever seen. Downloading the online house manual and adding it to my phone screen made it super easy to learn how to operate certain items in the house and on the sunny deck.The open concept design is not only beautiful but also practical. The kitchen is beautiful, and we spent significant amount of time cooking, drinking, and hanging out in the space. We are two couples who travel often together, and we each loved having our own king suite—not always possible in many Airbnb rentals. Jonathan and Anna thought of everything. We loved the hanging chairs near the sliding glass doors, we had cocktails out on the deck by the fire table, we used the gas grill for dinner, we played pool in the lower-level game room, and we played board games around the large dining table. Show more

name: Lisa
text: The detailed guidebook, wide variety of amenities, open floor plan, epic views, comfy beds, fancy fireplace, spacious/well-stocked kitchen, all-inclusive smart TVs, and games galore are just a few of the reasons this place is a perfect weekend getaway. It's walking distance to a ski lift (we didn't ski, but it was fun watching others do it!). The house is dog friendly, and the host(s) are so friendly and communicative. Easy check-in and check-out. We spent a quiet weekend here for a belated family Christmas, and it was absolutely perfect. Great AirBnB experience all around. ☺️

name: Sukriti
text: Absolutely loved our families experience at the Aspen House.

name: Monica
text: Jonathan's home was well equipped for all our needs. It has beautiful views to wake up to and the swings in the home were a favorite spot for all! I would highly recommend this home!! Jonathan was very quick to respond and helpful!

name: Stephanie
text: What a beautiful home! Jonathan was a fabulous (and communicative!) host and his listing accurately described the accommodations. The location was great for heading to Bryce Resort or looking for a fun getaway. The mountain views couldn't be beat! We would love to come again! Don't hesitate to book this home!!

name: Virginia
text: place so nice I booked it twice! Jonathan is super responsive and the location of his home can't be beat. thank you for the lovely stays!

name: Virginia
text: communication (10/10)location (10/10)amenities (10/10) view (1000000000/100)it was a bummer the Xbox didn't work but this house has a million and one games to play with friends and family. As a new parent I especially appreciated all the child amenities such as pack and play, baby gates, high chairs, baby utensils etc. great stay. would recommend.

name: Lauren
text: Everything was absolutely amazing! We had 8 adults ranging in sizes and shapes and everyone fit comfortably in the rooms, the table, outside etc..This place is going to be a go to for my group and we Jonathan had amazing communication and just overall house goals! Walmart is 30 mins away and Pizza Hut so stop before y'all come or you will be making that hike.

name: Dj
text: Perfect!

name: Dorothy
text: Jonathan is an amazing host. Speedy with responses and so quick to address any issues as small as not having enough room in the trash bin…he literally came out to empty it for us without us even knowing during the trip! The house itself is fantastic…they've really thought of everything from board games to video games, fully stocked kitchen appliances and more. This place also has the most glorious views and very central. You can't go wrong!

name: Chris
text: The Airbnb was amazing. I've stayed here once before and had a great stay both times. Jonathan was hands down the best host I've had the pleasure of having and was super attentive/quick to respond to each of my messages. The cabin itself was clean, fully stocked with everything my family could want/need, and obviously beautiful! 10/10 would definitely come back.

name: Michael
text: Jonathan's place was a great way to get family together for the holidays Andy have a spacious and cozy house with an amazing view. The beds are comfy, the location is almost directly on Bryce resort, which is great for a walk along the ridge line, and Jonathan is a very attentive host. Also, he surprised us with an arcade game during our stay. Highly recommend for seclusion and relaxation!

name: Kassie
text: Remote modern mountain house retreat. Go stay here now! The house is absolutely gorgeous inside. The back of the house has an amazing view of the mountains. We went in the fall and it was beautiful. Amenities are all updated and super comfortable beds. Can't wait to visit again!

name: Kevin
text: We had had a terrific time! The view was amazing, the location so quiet, and home so lovely. I appreciated the coffee set-up and stocked kitchen. We can't wait to come back again.

name: Zumi
text: This house has beautiful views and has everything you will ever need in a house. It was great for my friends and I because we love to cook and didn't need to buy any spices because the house came with all the spices we needed. It was such a great experience and will definitely book again.

name: Taylor
text: I wish I could give this AirBnB 10 stars. The pictures don't even do it justice! Every detail was so thought out and Jonathan was the best host ever!!! The views of the mountains were breathtaking and the house was SO cool!!! We will be back for sure!!!!!!

name: Erin
text: Loved the house! Clean and perfect for our family.

name: Tara
text: My husband and I had a relaxing weekend getaway with our seven-month-old, but we were commenting how this would be the ultimate family/friends stay too, with the pool table, board games, large dining area and decks. This home and the views are truly incredible. Everything is so well stocked with high quality items, bedding, etc. The bed is comfortable and master shower truly heavenly. We had a great time using the beautiful kitchen and grilling out. The fireplace is awesome - the Community Store down the street is great for starter logs & firewood, all your snacks and drinks. Lake Laura is also a must see for hiking!You won't regret staying here, it is amazing!

name: Maria
text: I was shocked at how stunning this house was. It felt so carefully put together and so welcoming. Spotless, well appointment and the view was unbeatable. Thank you so much— we will definitely return!!

name: Samantha
text: Gorgeous and newly renovated home with stunning views. Extremely comfortable bedrooms with plenty of space! We loved all of the attention to details, all of the included amenities and state of the art appliances and technology throughout the home. We highly recommend this home for friend groups or families. We left the house to go hiking and to go out to dinner one night, but otherwise there is no need to leave this house. We can't wait to be back!

name: Austin
text: Jonathan's place was lovely! The beds were super comfortable and the kitchen had everything we needed and more. Overall we really enjoyed our stay!One really nice thing that we appreciated was that originally, we were told that the espresso machine wasn't working, but Jonathan got it working and dropped it off during our visit.

name: Kaneda
text: Thank you for a wonderful stay. The renovations on the home are absolutely beautiful. We were in awe as soon as we stepped foot into the door. Jonathan's home provided ample room and amenities just like a resort. Not to mention the view on every floor was to die for! We created wonderful memories here. Everything you can think of is supplied within the home. There was an issue with garbage disposal in the kitchen, but Jonathan was prompt with his communication and resolved it efficiently. Overall, I am so grateful to have been able to celebrate my birthday in Jonathan's gorgeous abode! Thank you for your hospitality. We would love to book again in the future!

name: Christina
text: Very nice place! Wonderful views! Great shopping less than thirty minutes away!

name: Anjie
text: Jonathan, Thank you for such an AMAZING house to spend my 30th birthday. Tranquility at its finest! With such a crazy year of COVID, the phrase of "peace be still" is the ultimate definition of this house and was peaceful! The scenery alone could not be placed in words you just have to see it for yourself. So If you are looking for a week/weekend getaway with friends, families, or even a small retreat this house is perfect for you! I enjoyed my stay and the activities we experience near was such a great experience. I am looking forward to my next stay at this house!- Anjie

name: Cynthia
text: This is a great place for a quiet mountain get away! Views were amazing! Dining options are few in the area, but kitchen is perfect for cooking!

name: Brent
text: Jonathan was a fantastic house and the house was simply stunning. We arrived at night so we couldn't see the views from the back patio(s) until we woke up the following morning but when we did….WOW!! Breathtaking!!This was a great place to celebrate my 40th birthday but I would stay here again even without a special occasion on the calendar.Fantastic space! 10/10 would recommend. Thanks Jonathan.

name: Katie
text: This house was wonderful for our family getaway. It is super clean and has great space for gathering and privacy. And yes, the views are spectacular! Many calming deep breaths were taken standing on the multiple decks. Ours was a short stay but we took advantage of some local hikes and the driving range at the resort which was fun and relaxing. The kitchen is well stocked for cooking, which is good because we found that restaurants were a bit more of a drive than we would like. Also many of them were not open on Monday and Tuesday-perhaps due to our timing in the season or Covid related issues-so we cooked more than I was expecting to, but that added to our time together, which was important. Oh and our canine guest loved the special amenities just for her! Also, Jonathan is extremely easy and quick to communicate with. This Airbnb experience was a step above for sure. Thank you!

name: Dick
text: Exactly as described - great views, clean and spacious. It was a good week for all of us there at Jonathon's place.

name: Cindy
text: This airbnb experience truly exceeded our group's expectations. From before we arrived till after we left, Jonathan was accommodating and hospitable. Since our check in wasn't until 4 PM, our group wasn't sure what to do before, but thankfully, Jonathan provided suggested some wineries, breweries, and places we could visit before. In addition to being very responsive to our questions, Jonathan was nice enough to send a bracelet that we had left with no extra cost. In addition to Jonathan's kindness, our group also appreciated the link that Jonathan provided - this link provides explanations how to use the different amenities in the house, lists of local places to eat and drink, and rules/check out instructions. Like others have mentioned in the reviews, the house is amazing and beautiful. The rooms are so clean and neat with comfortable beds. The bathrooms are stocked with high end products for use. There is so much to do in the house with your group. The kitchen is spacious and has all the tools and gadgets you will need. The view from the balcony is breathtaking. I could go on and on about the home, but you should experience this home yourself because you will not regret it!

name: Allison
text: This home was perfect for a group with or without kids. The house was amazing and stocked better than anybody her aibnb!

name: Lolita
text: This was our BEST Airbnb experience. Everything was PERFECT about this house. And we will definitely come back!

name: Margaret
text: Jonathan and his property are great! Jonathan was extremely responsive and accommodating. The house had all the amenities we needed, and I really appreciated how well stocked it was so we did not have to bring a ton of extra stuff. The guide he put together was incredibly helpful. Lastly, the view was amazing.

name: Molly
text: Five of us spent a peaceful & relaxing stay here; it was even nicer than we hoped based on the listing. The beds were comfortable; the kitchen was so well-stocked: we cooked & baked & made cocktails all week long. bathroom amenities were top-notch, better than many hotels, as were the amenities for dogs & we played several of the board games, too. The views were gorgeous & all the outdoor seating options made for many lazy afternoons. Pizza from Basye Brew Hollow, just down the mountain was surprisingly delicious. All-around an A+ vacation!

name: Alice
text: We had a super peaceful experience in this beautiful home nestled in the heart of nature. The view is magical. We loved the swinging egg chairs in the perfect spot for sipping coffee and marveling in the view. The owners created such a lovely space with their special touch on decor and the kitchen experience was nice with all the little things. They have a little google speaker if ya wanna play some tunes, I learned that you have to say "Hey Google", Hello, Namaste' or Hey you doesn't work. Anyways, to get away from technology is nice too. Enjoy the house, it's a lovely find. Namaste'

name: Rajesh
text: Everything in the house was thought through so well. I was surprised with the attention to details in every aspects of the house and in every corners I can think of. House is beautifully located with great view! I highly recommend the house!!!

name: Kei
text: As other reviewers say, Jonathan's house will exceed your expectation. As you walk into the house for the first time, you will be greeted but the breathtaking views and gorgeous/very uniquely designed main floor (I am sure everyone's first word will be WOW!). This is our second time staying at Jonathan's home (first on this particular one) and Jonathan is always so easy to communicate and very prompt to respond both effort and during the stay.A house is perfect for 2 families with children and is very well stocked with almost everything you would need (Jonathan's description of what's provided is very accurate and he will let you know what's available there if you ask). A kitchen is large and is also well stocked with every basic cooking items and utensils. There are more than enough tablewares, glasses, cups and large serving wares. Bathrooms are also well stocked with high end products and towels - make you really feel like you are staying at 5 star resort. I especially appreciated the personal size sunscreens. Beds and bed lines are so comfortable as well. We did some outdoor activities but mostly enjoyed our time in the beautiful home/relaxing time on the deck with a view. His information mentions bugs but we were pleasantly surprised there were no mosquitos so were able to enjoy our time on the deck (and weather during our stay was perfect). Other bugs were not an issue at all. We could tell throughout the house how Jonathan and Anna went above and beyond to provide their guests a comfortable and very special stay/experience. We would definitely love to come back!! Thank you!! Show more

name: Dominique
text: Jonathan did an amazing job with this place!! We will be back ASAP with our family. Loved the communication and everything's as well stocked We appreciated that!!

name: Dorinda
text: I was so excited to find this house for our large party and Jonathan's house did not disappoint! We had 4 adults and 6 teenagers and everyone had a great time. The pool table was awesome. The sleeping accommodations were perfect for us. The view was gorgeous and we were close to activities. The WiFi worked great and we appreciate that in the mountains, as my husband must work even when we are away. In previous houses he has had to leave to find a place to connect but this time he could at least work where the rest of us were. Hugely helpful. Also appreciate that dogs were allowed. We definitely enjoyed our stay and would love to stay again!

name: Vipul
text: Jonathan's home is beautiful. Thoughtfully designed and spacious - it's a great home base for a weekend getaway.

name: Avia
text: Amazing house ! Very clean, it seems that everything was thought of.Great design, wonderful view.Definitely hope to be back

name: Alison
text: This space was so perfect for our extended family gathering! We loved waking up to the views and had so much space to gather together or spread out a bit. The home is even bigger than we expected and slept ten comfortably. The kitchen is big enough for multiple people to work at the same time and is better stocked than any I have seen! Jonathan was very responsive and helpful to us and the guide he provided for our stay was amazing! We would absolutely stay there again and recommend to our friends. Five stars!!!

name: Maira
text: Perfect get away house, we had a blast ans the views were breathtaking!

name: Lawrence
text: Great place even better view. Simply an amazing place to stay.

name: Wanda
text: This incredible home away from home is the perfect retreat. It's only a 2 hour drive from Washington, DC but the seclusion and view will make you feel like you are out of country. There are balconies on each level, hanging chairs that feel like personal indoor hammocks, beds that feel like you've purchased them yourself, a kitchen that is so inviting that you will want to cook breakfast and dinner the entirety of your stay, and bathrooms that rival your most recent luxury hotel stay. Jonathan has thought of everything for you. Man's best friend has a bed here, no need to bring one. His bowl and waste bags are here too. No need to bring those either. The fireplace, even in the summer, will support your s'mores fix. Jonathan never took an hour to respond. If you have a question, just ask! Lastly, his guestbook really answers ALL of your questions and it, too, is a thing of beauty. We will most definitely return. I don't know if he is a "super host", but I'm telling you—he is a SUPER HOST with a fabulous home he has shared with you. This is the one. You won't be disappointed.

name: Kerry
text: This review just has to start with the amazing view from Jonathan's lovely home! We had a pretty stressful week with weather related travel challenges, a family funeral and other distractions before we arrived at Jonathan's home. The minute we walked in the front door we were captivated by the view - all the tension melted away and we knew this was going to be a terrific stay! The home was beautifully finished and the layout was perfect for our family of 10. The design was very well thought out and we had every comfort and convenience we needed. The kitchen was clearly one of the best stocked with all the tools and gadgets we could ever need! Jonathan's communications were without a doubt the best we've ever experienced in our years of rentals. His guide was extremely helpful and informative and made our stay extremely easy and a lot of fun. If only all hosts we are gracious and helpful as Jonathan! We highly recommend this lovely home and only wish all hosts put in the effort, care and attention Jonathan does! He sets the standard for hosts! Can't wait to come visit again - and still dreaming of that view!!

name: Lindsey
text: WOW. Jonathan's home deserves way more than 5 stars, this is by far the best airbnb that I have ever stayed at. As others have shared, this house is even better than the beautiful pictures. Everything was perfect. From the moment we walked in, we were absolutely blown away. The absolutely gorgeous home is only matched by the incredible view (the deck was the most perfect place to work from for the week!). The home came fully equipped with everything that we needed—from the kitchen, to the toiletries to the phone charging pods by the bed. Every detail was thought out with care. The bedrooms were all gorgeous and the beds were so comfortable that I purchased all of the bedding for my own home - haha. When we booked there were no reviews, but i am SO happy we took the chance on this incredible home. We couldn't have dreamed of a better experience. We barely left the house, but we did take a trip to a nearby winery for an afternoon, while a few in our group played golf nearby. We would absolutely love to return again one day!

name: Kevin
text: Amaizing views, very comfortable beds, and the home had everything we needed to have a friend's group get away for a weekend. Kitchen had all the necessities for us to cook, and we had plenty of space to hang out in groups!

name: Gurpriya
text: A beautiful house with an amazing view! The five bedrooms and the multiple bathrooms were more than enough room for our family! And everything was so modern - made our stay super comfortable

name: Tyler
text: 5 stars all around. The home was amazing and we had a fantastic time. Somehow even with all the photos, they do not do the home justice. We loved the layout. We will go back for sure.

name: Sean
text: the house was awesome. the pictures didn't do the house justice! Jonathan was very responsive.

name: Rose
text: No false advertising here. This place is even better than pictured. We could not get over the views and the design let's you appreciate the location all day long! This home is so well supplied and created with top of the line appliances. Jonathan responded to all questions right away and was so helpful with local recommendations. If you are looking for a mountain hideaway this place is perfect! We cannot wait to book again!

name: Reza
text: WOW. JUST WOW. Where to begin?! This is hands down one of the best airbnbs that I have stayed in. I booked Jonathan's place for a last minute Mother's Day getaway. The house was perfect for four adult couples (and room for more). The house is absolutely gorgeous and the view is INCREDIBLE! Jonathan was extremely responsive during our entire stay. The attention to detail in this home is second to none. The kitchen is stocked with anything you would ever need for a lovely, stress-free getaway. We enjoyed hiking and scenic walks in the local area.

name: Brenda
text: My brothers and I were looking for the perfect place to surprise our mom ahead of Mother's Day and I'm so glad we found Jonathan's place! You can tell a lot of thought was put not only into the luxurious design but Jonathan also ensured to stock the house with all high-end items, from the kitchen, down to the face moisturizers (the espresso machine was my favorite). Check-in/out was a breeze as Jonathan was an ease to communicate with. He made sure we felt comfortable staying in his place and even accommodated our request for an early check-in. The fireplace and the pool table made it the perfect staycation house. Now, the best part... the VIEWS. The floor to ceiling windows provides you the most beautiful panoramic view of the mountains. Honestly, the photos does no justice. Safe to say, Jonathan's place certainly exceeded our expectations. We will definitely be coming back!

name: Heath
text: This is such a great house!! Beautiful views and decor. It was immaculate and easy to get to! We love the Bryce Resort area and have been going for years but Jonathan's house is our new go-to. It was super comfortable, clean and well stocked with spices etc. and built in baby-gates! They truly thought of everything. Communication was fantastic. And was east to connect with while we were there when we had questions. (Although most of ours could have been answered if we read the well provided digital welcome book 🤷🏽‍♀️)The only thing to consider is the noise (given open floor plan) does travel up. So if hanging in basement and kids asleep upstairs, the provided sound machines proved 💯. Jonathan also warned us the upstairs A/C can be loud but it worked to our benefit for extra white noise. Overall this house is wonderful! Already looking at the calendar to go back.

name: Alec
text: This is the ideal AirBnB stay. Jonathan's place is hands down the best experience I have ever had using AirBnB. The space is immaculately clean with top tier amenities. Every single bed is of the highest quality with comfortable pillows and sheets. The bathrooms are spa-like with modern features and Johnathan was nice to include many items for us to use in case we forgot our toiletries. The kitchen has brand new, state of the art appliances that made using the kitchen space not just a breeze, but part of the fun. There are multiple large televisions to use when you want to experience some down time not enjoying the outdoors as well. Johnathan stocked the home with board games and video games in addition to the pool table. We loved all of the above but the best feature of his space is honestly the gorgeous views of the mountains. The home comes with 3 decks, including a private deck for one of the upstairs bedrooms. They come with ample seating and bars to make dining outside a breeze. I honestly can't speak highly enough of this place. We're already looking at future dates for when we can return to experience the local wineries.
